newsitem.title: EU: EP CIVIL LIBERTIES COMMITTEE AGENDA - DEC 2-3.
newsitem.headline: EP CIVIL LIBERTIES COMMITTEE AGENDA - DEC 2-3.

text.p: Committee on Civil Liberties and Internal Affairs [[ Monday 02 December 1996 ]] 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE219.574 ) ===] In the presence of the Council and Commission 2. Chairman's announcements 3. Exchange of views with Mr Marc FISCHBACH, Luxembourg Justice Minister, Chair man-in-Office of the Schengen Executive Committee 4. Annual debate on progress in JHA in 1996 (T04969) INI0891 INI0891 + LIBE Fond LINDEPERG Michele. (PSE) (PE218.469 ) - Adoption of motion for a resolution 5. Schengen: assessment, inclusion in Community law, forms of cooperation with third countries, etc. (T04613) INI0468 INI0468 + LIBE Fond R VAN LANCKER A. (PSE) (PE219.570 ) - Exchange of views Exchange of views on the basis of the draft report - Deadline for tabling amendments 6. Annual debate on racism (T04979) QUO0069 + LIBE Fond FORD James G. (PSE) (PE219.571 ) - rapporteur: Arie OOSTLANDER - Exchange of views Exchange of views (preparation for the annual debate on raci sm) 7. Coordinators' meeting at 6.30 p.m. (NO INTERPRETATION) ===] Tuesday 3 December 8. Exchange of views with Mr Georges ESTIEVENART, Director of the European Moni toring Centre for Drugs and Drug Addiction, Lisbon - on the annual report on the drugs problem in the European Union (PE219.573 ) 9. HEARING on the drugs problem - EUROPEAN CITIES ON DRUG POLICY, Frankfurt a/Main - EUROPEAN CITIES AGAINST DRUGS, Stockholm 10. Results of the coordinators' meeting on 2 December 11. Any other business 12. Date of next meeting - 10 December in Strasbourg (to be confirmed) - 16 and 17 December in Brussels - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
